# Crayon Roofing & Structures — Sales Call Knowledge Base (auto-distilled)

## Corpus summary

This corpus is dominated by **internal operations chatter** — loading/unloading coordination, driver directions to the factory (Andarkuppam check-post, Manali New Town, Chennai), vehicle booking, "ready ஆச்சா/இல்லையா" status checks, payment-collection follow-ups with existing dealers, and gift/relationship calls (Diwali gifts, fans, coolers). Only a **minority of calls are genuine sales conversations** — price enquiries, quotations, objection handling, and order closing. This KB is built strictly from that smaller genuine-sales subset; logistics/attendance/crane/driver calls were excluded.

Because the real sales sample is limited, treat the rate figures below as **anchors seen in these specific calls**, not as a full price list — they change frequently ("1st தேதி-ல இருந்து 10% ஏறுது", "next month prices will change").

The company — **Crayon Roofing and Structures** — is confirmed in the calls as a **JSW Steel authorized direct-distribution unit** in Chennai (factory: Andarkuppam check post, Manali New Town). It is **not a pure "roofing" company only** — the same team also sells hardware/consumables that go with roofing and structural steel work: screws, welding rods/electrodes, GI pipe, polycarbonate sheets, and puff (PUF) panels.

## Products & brand ladder

Based on explicit mentions in sales calls:

**1. Roofing/profile sheets (core product)** — sold by sq.meter rate or by kg, in standard colour-coated steel:
- **JSW Color-on Plus** — premium tier. "இது top-ஆ Color-on Plus" — 0.47mm/0.50mm thickness.
- **JSW Pragathi** — mid tier (0.47mm only; does not come in 0.50mm — "Pragathi-ல வராது 45 தான் வரும்").
- **JSW Silver-on / Silver-on Plus** — another branded line, used interchangeably with Color-on when stock is short ("Radiance-ல stock இல்ல, Color-on-ல தான் குடுக்க சொன்னாரு").
- **Asian Indradhanush** — a cheaper, non-JSW alternative (0.45mm) explicitly used when customer finds JSW too costly. Team is aware this is the product competitors undercut them with.
- **JSW brand also referenced generically as "JSW" for export/cold-call pitches.**
- Thickness range offered: 0.45mm, 0.47mm, 0.50mm (also 1mm/1.2mm heavier "duck sheet" variant for industrial use).
- Colours: sky blue, dark blue, off-white, half-white (no "pure white"/aluminium white — only half-white), grey, brick red, "Caliphate Green"/CFG (printed JSW batch roll), cream (9001 — not stocked, half-white offered instead).
- GSM variant: "150 GSM" printed sheet mentioned for a 4000 sq.m bulk enquiry.

**2. Accessories for roofing** — purlins (Parlin), L-flash, ridge caps, down-takes, profile rolls (plain/4ft roll), polycarbonate "profile" sheets for natural light sections.

**3. Polycarbonate sheets** — sold as roll, profile-rolled on their own machine to match roof profile ("நம்ம machine-லயே ஓட்டுறாங்க… profile-ஆ ஓட்டி கொடுப்பாங்க"). 2mm thickness referenced.

**4. PUF (Puff) panels** — 50mm roof panel quoted at ₹1600+GST per sq.meter (top & bottom thickness mentioned separately, loading extra).

**5. GI Pipe** — 2mm thickness, "GI hard dip," sizes like 60x40, 40x40 mentioned; sourced from a separate vendor ("Sir கிட்ட பேசிட்டு... G எல்லாம் சாதா டீல் பண்றாங்க").

**6. Hardware / consumables** (clearly cross-sold alongside sheets):
- **Screws** — Tata-brand self-drilling/hex-head screws only (no "local" or nails — "Nails இல்லை sir, screws தான் இருக்கு"). Sizes: 1 inch, 19mm stitch screw, 35mm cladding screw, 65mm half-thread/FD/DT variants.
- **Welding rods/electrodes** — Tata brand, 10mm & 12mm, sold by "case"/"cotton" (1 cotton = 12 packets); minimum order ~5 cases; credit extended on this item separately from sheet billing ("இதுதான் cash and carry மாதிரி படுத்துறோம்").

**7. Structural items referenced but not deeply detailed**: square bar, M-Stand, kattukambi (reinforcement bar — for this the rep refers customer out to "Watson Steel," indicating it's NOT their own product).
